name: find_matching_table_entry_byte
description: Scans 8-byte table entries from a pointer until the byte at offset 2 matches the input byte, leaving the pointer on the matched entry.

name: unpack_bitstream_block
description: Unpacks a block using a 32-bit bit buffer read from the input, with carry bits selecting literal runs or back-references. It writes output until the size stored in the block header is reached.

name: service_interrupt_request_counters
description: Interrupt-style handler that checks request bits in the interrupt request and enable registers. It increments two counters when a particular request bit is set, sets a flag once one counter passes two, and then clears the request bits.

name: fill_plane_pointer_table
description: Writes a series of 32-bit addresses into 8-byte table entries, starting from a base value and advancing by 8000 for each entry. It stores the low word at offset 6 and the high word at offset 2 of each entry.

name: load_palette_from_table
description: Copies 32 words from a source table into the colour registers, starting at the first colour register. It then returns.

name: store_serial_bit_in_bitmap
description: Handles one step of a serial input word: when its high bit is set it toggles a parity flag, and on one phase it writes a single bit into a 128-bit bitmap at an index taken from the input and a lookup table. The facts list the CIA serial and control registers.

name: undecoded_bit_change_routine
description: Twelve instructions including a bit-change operation at an address-taken entry. The decompiler gave no pseudo-code, so the behaviour is not recovered.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PaRaDoX:0:0000
name: load_hunk_executable
description: Program entry that walks AmigaDOS hunk headers, comparing type codes, and allocates and frees memory through exec. It appears to load an Amiga executable, as the hunk comparisons indicate.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PaRaDoX:0:017C
name: delay_countdown_loop
description: Counts a 16-bit register down from its starting value through the full range until it wraps, producing a fixed delay with no other effect.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PaRaDoX:0:01CC
name: decode_bit_packed_run_block
description: Reads a length from the input word, then repeatedly calls a shifted-flag check and writes the decoded values to an output buffer. The loop continues until the length is consumed.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PaRaDoX:0:0218
name: pull_bits_from_shift_register
description: Pulls bits from a multi-word shift register using a bit count held in one register, reloading a longword when the register runs empty. The results are formed from the shifted-out bits and written to the output.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:PaRaDoX:0:026C
name: invalidate_caches_then_fault
description: Traps into the system to invalidate cache lines and then reaches a bad-data fault. The fault marks the end of decodable code.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Bubba:0:0000
name: walk_startup_pointer_list
description: Program entry that walks a zero-terminated list of pointers, using each entry's value to choose a branch of work and calling one routine as it goes. The decompiled body is long and only partly recovered.

key: bubba 'n' stix (1994)(core design)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubba 'N' Stix (1994)(Core Design)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Bubba:0:01E2
name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work, so it acts as an empty callback target.

name: init_copper_and_input_loop
description: Sets up two copper pointers, disables an interrupt, and waits for the blitter before running a loop. Each pass calls eight routines and reads the button state.

name: wait_status_then_set_bit
description: Waits until a status byte equals a fixed value and a flag byte is nonzero, then returns the input word with the bit at the input index set.

name: wait_status_flag_ready
description: Waits until a status byte equals a fixed value and a flag byte is nonzero, then returns without changing anything.

name: run_until_flag_clears
description: Sets a global to one, then repeatedly calls two routines, one at a fixed address, until the global reads zero.

name: init_plane_and_entry_tables
description: Fills 16 longwords with addresses spaced 131072 bytes apart, then sets eight table entries to a fixed word and a stride value.

name: advance_timed_event_sequence
description: Decrements a delay counter and, when it reaches zero, advances through a table of timed entries to the first entry above the current value. It updates the event state and writes the next value into the table.

name: select_copper_pointer_for_frame
description: Reduces a position word modulo 80, then selects one of three copper-list addresses by a toggle and a state flag. It stores the low and high words of that address into the copper pointer slots.

name: pack_sprite_control_bytes
description: Writes four bytes into a record: the low bytes of two position values and their sum, plus a flags byte that records the high bit of each value. The layout matches the hardware sprite control words.

name: step_position_state_machine
description: Writes a value into two copper pointer slots and moves a position by four units in a direction set by a state value. It changes state when a bound is reached.

name: init_record_defaults_after_wait
description: Waits until a status bit clears, then sets three longwords of a record to fixed defaults. It stores a combination of its two input words into the record.

name: clear_audio_dma_state
description: Builds table entries from a sorted byte table, clearing each entry's words at a fixed stride and resetting several globals. The facts also list the four audio volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

name: tick_audio_and_reload_pointers
description: Increments a tick counter and, when it reaches its limit, runs four update routines, pauses with two countdown loops, and writes the four audio channel address register pairs from table values. The counter is then marked as ready.

name: apply_music_channel_effect
description: Runs the nibble-selected effect step for one audio channel, updating a word from a table indexed by a global counter modulo 3. The result is written to the channel's audio register, using the same dispatch as the other effect handlers.

name: load_audio_instrument_entry
description: Reads a 30-byte entry from an instrument table and copies its start address, length, volume and period fields into the channel state. It then writes the channel's address and length registers and updates the DMA control register.

name: apply_effect_command_to_record
description: Applies the nibble-selected effect step to one object record, updating its position word from a table indexed by a nibble and the global counter. It first calls the sprite-entry clearing routine and stores the result in the record.

name: copy_record_position_word
description: Copies the 16-bit field at offset 16 of the record into the output slot passed by the caller and returns. It is a single move with no branching.

name: find_threshold_table_entry
description: Scans a threshold table selected by a record index for the first entry at or below the record's masked position value, falling back to a fixed entry when none match. It stores the chosen value in the record and sets a direction flag when that value is below the record's target.

name: step_position_toward_target
description: Moves a 16-bit position toward its target by a per-step delta, snapping to the target and clearing the target field once it is reached. It then stores the result with a control nibble in the record's control word.

name: compute_wave_offset_step
description: Computes an offset from a phase byte and a 4-bit amplitude, taken from a table, a ramp or a fixed maximum depending on a mode field, and applies the sign. It adds the offset to the stored base value and advances the phase.

name: run_record_effect_command
description: Runs a command selected by the low nibble of a record's command byte: command 9 scales a parameter into a counter, command 11 stores a fixed value, and command 13 combines two nibbles and clamps at 63. It first calls the sprite-entry clearing routine.

name: store_record_low_nibble
description: Copies the low nibble of the record's parameter byte into a second record field and returns. It is a single field update with no branching.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:0000
name: run_installer_from_workbench
description: Program entry that checks whether the task has a CLI and, when it was started from Workbench, fetches the startup message. It calls the main routine and then replies to the message if one was received.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:0074
name: init_gadget_record_fields
description: Fills a gadget record with the position values, the flags and activation words, and a pointer to its image data, then records it as the last gadget. The fields are copied from the caller's values and global defaults.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:0078
name: make_boolean_gadget
description: Builds a boolean gadget record by filling its position, flags and activation fields and linking it as the last gadget. It calls the record-filling routine for the common fields.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:012C
name: set_default_gadget_pens
description: Sets the default boolean gadget values: no flags, activation 1, front pen 2, back pen 3 and draw mode 0.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:0166
name: build_and_draw_border
description: Fills a border structure with a series of coordinate pairs and a pen value, links its vertex list, and draws it with the intuition border routine.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:0278
name: print_intuition_text
description: Sets the text record's text pointer and position to zero, then calls the intuition routine that prints an IText record.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:02B8
name: open_window_with_definition
description: Stores four 16-bit values into the new-window definition, then calls the intuition routine that opens a window.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:02C4
name: run_install_window_sequence
description: Creates the installer window and sequences its library and device work using the libraries, the trackdisk device and the disk file names listed in its facts. It prints installer messages such as Please wait and Operation Aborted.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:07EA
name: make_panel_screen
description: Creates the Cancel and Start gadgets, opens the panel window, then draws its border and title text and calls one more intuition routine. It returns 1 on success and 0 when the window fails to open.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:Install.BTL:0:0838
name: open_main_panel_screen
description: Points the title and start gadget fields at their data and opens the panel window. When the window opens it draws the border and text and calls one more intuition routine, returning 1; otherwise it returns 0.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: bootblock_build_region_table
description: Boot block entry that walks a linked list of memory entries, storing each entry's start value into a table before calling other routines. The pseudo-code is only partly recovered, so this description covers only that part.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:00C0
name: trap_and_jump_relocated
description: Sets a vector word and a trap-handler pointer, issues trap 1, and then jumps to a fixed offset from a global base. It is a short entry stub.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:00D4
name: trap_one_then_jump
description: Issues trap 1 and then jumps to a fixed offset from a global base. It is a short entry stub that depends on the handler set by its neighbour.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:00FA
name: allocate_span_from_pairs
description: Scans pairs of values until it finds a negative marker, and otherwise reserves a fixed span by writing its start value and the adjusted end value into the pair.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:011A
name: init_disk_sync_and_dma
description: Disables all interrupts, sets the disk sync word, and enables DMA bits. It also writes the CIA port data-direction registers to output and installs a handler pointer.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0170
name: compute_disk_track_range
description: Divides a block range by 11 to get track and sector numbers for its start and end, stores them, and waits on a CIA status bit before continuing.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:01B8
name: set_disk_step_control
description: Stores a computed position from a register word and writes two drive control bytes to a CIA port register.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:01DE
name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work, so it acts as an empty callback target.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:01F0
name: set_cia_timer_and_wait
description: Writes two byte values to CIA timer registers, then waits until a status bit is set.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:020E
name: step_head_until_target
description: Alternates a CIA drive-control bit on each step of a counter, calling a routine for each step, until the counter reaches the target stored in the record. It stores the final position.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:021A
name: seek_head_to_target_track
description: Clears a drive-control bit, then steps a counter and sets or clears the bit on each pass until the counter equals the record's target. It stores the final position.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0234
name: store_position_field
description: Stores the input word into the record's position field and returns.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:023A
name: stub_endless_call_loop
description: Sets a counter field to 10, then repeatedly calls two routines in a loop whose exit flag is never set, so it does not return.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0250
name: start_disk_dma_and_wait
description: Writes a buffer address and a disk length word, twice, to start a read, then waits until a status bit is set.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0278
name: decode_mfm_sector_blocks
description: Scans a buffer for MFM sync words, then decodes the odd and even bit halves of each sector header and data word using an alternating-bit mask. The decoded values are checked before they are stored.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:02CE
name: verify_sector_checksum_then_decode
description: XORs the words of a sector header to form a checksum, returns if it does not match the expected mask, and otherwise decodes the sector data.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0320
name: set_drive_bit_and_wait
description: Writes a control byte derived from a bit position, sets a CIA timer, then waits for a status bit to clear. It returns early when the status bit is already clear.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0354
name: step_track_by_difference
description: Stores a new track value and steps the head one track at a time, in the direction needed, until it reaches the track of the previous value.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:036E
name: delay_full_word_count
description: Calls one routine on every pass of a 16-bit counter until it wraps back to zero, producing a fixed delay of 65536 calls.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:0376
name: select_drive_and_start_timer
description: Clears and sets drive-control bits, writes a CIA timer byte and a mode byte, then waits until a status bit is set.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:037C
name: set_bits_and_start_timer
description: Sets one drive-control bit, clears another, writes a timer byte and a mode byte, then waits until a status bit is set.

key: brian the lion (1994)(psygnosis)(disk 1 of 3)[cr cls]/Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf:bootblock:0:03B8
name: issue_conditional_io_request
description: When a flag bit is set, fills an I/O request with a command, a memory address, a length and an offset, sends it with the exec DoIO call, and calls the loaded routine at that address. It then clears the flag global.

key: Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf boot-block load +$59600 to $060000 (4608 bytes):0:00D2
name: select_half_or_input
description: Returns the input word unchanged unless a register flag equals one, in which case it returns half of another word.

key: Brian the Lion (1994)(Psygnosis)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CLS].adf boot-block load +$59600 to $060000 (4608 bytes):0:00EA
name: lookup_masked_table_word
description: Looks up a word in a table at a fixed address, indexed by a doubled input value, and returns it ANDed with the second input word.

name: copy_words_to_two_destinations
description: Copies 32 words from a source pointer into two destinations, one a global and one a second fixed address, and stores the source pointer in a global.

name: copy_words_to_two_destinations
description: Copies 32 words from a source pointer into two destinations, one a global and one a second fixed address. It has the same behaviour as its neighbour.

name: stub_infinite_wait_loop
description: Contains only an endless empty loop that never returns. The decompiled body performs no reads or writes.

name: delay_then_clear_cia_flag
description: Counts down a fixed delay, clears one bit in the CIA-A register, then writes a fixed value to the interrupt request register.

name: stub_infinite_wait_loop
description: Contains only an endless empty loop that never returns. The gap decodes as unreached code, and the body performs no reads or writes.
